notes: Questions: 703-777-0343. Also see PRCS Connect (bit.ly/PRCSteens) for current teen programs.
name: Loudoun Parks and Recreation Teen Volunteer Program
org: Loudoun County Parks, Recreation and Community Services (PRCS)
what_you_do: Volunteer in many county rec programs and earn service hours. Look in the volunteer portal for teen openings.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18. The page does not state a residency rule.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply any time.
how_to_apply: Look for teen openings in the Loudoun volunteer portal. Then send the PRCS volunteer application.
